meta.title: Interface polish
meta.description: One appearance layer for every plugin: buttons highlight on hover, keyboard focus is visible, fields and scrollbars follow the theme, long paragraphs are justified, and plugin descriptions collapse. The Appearance settings include a “Panels in the left menu” card: the list is collected automatically from the sidebar.panellist slot, so a new plugin shows up there without code changes. Every panel has a “Show in the left sidebar” switch and “Pin” buttons in the “More” menu; new panels are visible and pinned by default, and the known plugins (Cards, Dialog compression, Review changes, Notifications, Team, Vault, Pyrus, Inbox, Interface polish, Whale helper, Launch browser) get their emoji by id. The plugin registers its own “Interface polish” panel and opens these settings on it, without plugin-manager service blocks; the other panels are registered by their plugins. dsh-polish stores the state (localStorage dsh-polish:panel-visibility) and announces changes with the dsh-polish:panels-changed event. Its own page shows the environment health (sync, GitHub token, Chrome, MCP, versions) and can check and install plugin updates. The appearance can be switched off with one checkbox.
